Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit for Kicad PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit for Kicad by: PCBWay Oct 11,2023 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Recently, PCBWay added a plug-in called PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit to Kicad: With just one click of the mouse, four files can be exported from the layout file automatically: Gerber file, IPC-Netlist file, BOM file and Pick and Place file, which can significantly improves the efficiency of pre-production work. Installation from the Official KiCad Repositories After installation, the plugin will appear on the right side of the navigation bar. And users can use it to export all the production files with just a click. Process demonstration： Sending the files to PCBWay, and they can be used for production after being reviewed by the staff. Note: If you want to place an assembly order, please be sure to add MPN information to the BOM. This can help the quoter source the devices you need more accurately. Manual installation Except for the way mentioned before, you can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Fabrication-Toolkit-for-KiCad: Open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About BOM Through BOM files, we can get all information of the components used in your design. In order to speed up the quotation process, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6.
